# Fixture licenses

The fixture page content, layouts, shapes, expected text, expected geometry, and
corpus metadata are dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0. The complete
license text is at `../LICENSE-CC0-1.0.txt`.

The fixtures are rendered with the already-committed Liberation Sans Regular
and Bold fonts. Those font files are licensed under the SIL Open Font License
1.1; the complete license text is at
`../../../../public/pdfjs/web/standard_fonts/LICENSE_LIBERATION`. The font files
are build inputs and are not copied into this fixture directory.

The bundled OCR model is not part of the fixture corpus and no model copy is
created here. Its existing license record is at
`../../../../docs/ocr/phase-a/licenses/PaddleOCR-Apache-2.0.txt`.
